description: Given an API that is dead, paywalled, rate-limiting you, or simply unsuitable, returns free alternatives in the same category ranked by measured uptime. Use this when an integration breaks or an API goes paid.

api.description: The API you are replacing, by slug or name, e.g. 'dark-sky', 'twitter'.

limit.description: Maximum alternatives to return. Default 5, max 20.

name: find_alternatives
title: Find working alternatives to an API
